measurement_statistical.note: the formal fit uncertainty is NOT the error budget

reference_systematic.affects: ABSOLUTE offset only; spatial gradients and hotspot contrast are invariant to the choice

processing_sensitivity.unwrap_correction: changed the descending product materially (7/7 internal metrics) but is NOT applicable to the authoritative ascending product

cross_geometry.per_hotspot: H001 and H004 agree at the rate level; H002/H003 do not reproduce; H005 contradicts

temporal_non_stationarity.note: the dominant uncertainty in any single quoted rate; larger than every statistical interval

combination_policy: These are NOT combined into a single +/- value. They are different kinds of quantity (statistical, systematic, sensitivity, structural) and no valid probabilistic model justifies summing them.
